$description: Levves type. A styled grotesque for titles and big numbers, a plain sans for everything you read or press, mono for code only. No serif, no caps labels.

display.$description: Window and section titles, headings, readout numbers

sans.$description: Body text, rows, fields, keys, labels, and every inline number (tabular figures)

serif.$description: Deprecated: no serif in Urban Flora; points at display until the pieces move off it

semibold.$description: Titles, labels, the current tab, the name in a row

body.$description: Body text and rows: a touch heavier than regular, for reading on dark

label.$description: Labels: section and column headers, sentence case

body-touch.$description: Phone body text and fields (iOS zooms into fields under 16px)

number.$description: Inline numbers, in sans with tabular figures

bar.$description: The top bar's text and readings

title.$description: Window and pane titles, in display

heading.$description: A screen's heading on the phone

readout.$description: A number in a readout, in display

readout-large.$description: The one big number of a screen

label.$description: Labels are sentence case with normal spacing
